title: Curried Cauliflower Chickpea Soup
description: A creamy, spiced soup with cauliflower, chickpeas, and coconut milk
instructions: Chop the cauliflower into florets and dice the onion
Sauté onion, minced garlic, and ginger in a large pot until fragrant
Stir in curry powder and toast for 30 seconds
Add cauliflower, drained chickpeas, and coconut milk
Simmer until the cauliflower is tender, about 20 minutes
Blend partially for a creamy texture with some chunks remaining, or serve as-is

title: Broccoli & Potato Soup
description: A comforting, blended soup of broccoli and potato
instructions: Dice the potato and onion
Melt butter in a large pot and sauté onion and garlic until soft
Add potato, broccoli, and enough water to cover; season with black pepper
Simmer until the vegetables are very tender, about 20 minutes
Blend until smooth and creamy

title: Tahini Kale Salad with Chickpeas
description: A hearty massaged kale salad with a creamy tahini-lemon dressing
instructions: Remove the kale stems, chop the leaves, and massage with a little olive oil until softened
Whisk together tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, and a splash of water until smooth
Drain and rinse the chickpeas
Toss the kale with the chickpeas and dressing until well coated

title: Hummus & Veggie Lunch Bowl
description: A simple lunch bowl of homemade hummus with fresh vegetables
instructions: Blend drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, and olive oil until smooth, adding water as needed
Slice the cucumber, carrot, and bell pepper into sticks
Divide the hummus between bowls and arrange the vegetables alongside

title: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Granola & Berries
description: Layered yogurt, granola, and mixed berries with a drizzle of honey
instructions: Spoon a layer of greek yogurt into a glass or bowl
Add a layer of granola, then a layer of mixed berries
Repeat the layers
Finish with a drizzle of honey

title: Veggie & Egg Scramble
description: A quick savory scramble with bell pepper, onion, and kale
instructions: Dice the bell pepper and onion, and roughly chop the kale
Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté the bell pepper and onion until softened
Add the kale and cook until wilted
Whisk the eggs with black pepper, pour into the skillet, and scramble until just set

title: Roasted Cauliflower Steaks with Tahini Drizzle
description: Thick-cut roasted cauliflower with a bright tahini-lemon sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F
Slice each cauliflower head into thick steaks through the core
Brush with olive oil and season with black pepper
Roast until golden and tender, about 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, and a splash of water into a smooth sauce
Drizzle the sauce over the roasted cauliflower steaks before serving

title: Tropical Coconut Almond Smoothie
description: A dairy-free banana smoothie with coconut milk and almonds
instructions: Peel the bananas
Combine bananas, coconut milk, and almonds in a blender
Blend until smooth and creamy
Pour into glasses and serve immediately
